quarterly_data.quarter: JX Advanced Metals semi-annual report: H1 FY2026 (11-11-2025)
quarterly_data.signal: Six months to September 30, 2025 (semi-annual report, IFRS): revenue JPY 396,391 million (+17.6% year on year) and operating profit JPY 70,034 million (JPY 68,120 million a year earlier). Management attributes the growth to higher sales of its main products such as semiconductor sputtering targets and rolled copper foil despite a stronger yen (average JPY 146 per US dollar), with AI - especially demand for high-performance AI servers for generative-AI training and inference - driving the semiconductor and ICT materials markets. Segments: Semiconductor Materials sales JPY 83,121 million (+12.9%), segment profit JPY 19,026 million (JPY 15,774 million), as advanced logic and memory demand stayed at a high level; ICT Materials sales JPY 155,673 million (+41.1%), segment profit JPY 15,349 million (JPY 14,630 million), on rolled copper foil sales and wider adoption of its high-performance copper alloys in AI servers; Basic Materials sales JPY 160,977 million (+4.2%), segment profit JPY 40,430 million (JPY 42,775 million), down mainly on the loss of the prior year's gain on the partial MLCC share sale and lower equity-method income. Group R&D spending in the half was JPY 10,091 million.
